changes.comment: The provider's `mcpServerDescriptor` now targets Dreamux core's generic, channel-agnostic MCP shim: the descriptor args change from `feishu-mcp ...` to `channel-mcp --provider builtin:feishu --dispatcher <id> ...` (issue #209 cleanup, Q1). The MCP server name (`feishu`) and the tool surface (`reply` / `react` / `list_chat_bots`) are unchanged; only the host shim subcommand the descriptor points at is renamed, and a `--provider` ref is added (advisory — core resolves the live channel session from the dispatcher id). Core's old `feishu-mcp` shim and feishu-specific admin methods are gone; the shim is a blind conduit to the neutral `channel.invoke_tool` / `channel.list_tools` admin methods. Rebuild: none required — descriptors are regenerated at every dispatcher boot, never persisted.
